## Coming from BacaKomik?
On Android, Yoru is a new app next to BacaKomik. Before you uninstall BacaKomik, bring your library over: sync it with Drive in BacaKomik and sign in to Drive sync in Yoru, or back it up in BacaKomik and restore the file in Yoru (More → Backup & sync). The 2.17.0 notes have the details.

## Changes

### New
- Mihon extensions on Windows, macOS and Linux. Add a Mihon repo (such as Keiyoushi) in More → Extensions and install its extensions, as on Android. The first install downloads what they need to run, about 100 MB, once; the app itself stays the same size. Extensions that open a web page themselves also download a browser the first time, about 250–280 MB; most extensions never need it. A bar at the top shows both downloads.
- Desktop: Mihon extensions install their jar build, which runs there; Keiyoushi publishes one for every extension.

### Changed
- An AVIF page that this device can't show (Android 11 and older, the desktops) now says so, with Open in browser, instead of a retry that fails again. Image hosts are asked for AVIF only where it can be shown.

### Fixed
- VoraToon covers load again. Its covers are links that expire after six days: bookmark refresh now fetches a new one when the stored link expired, history and Continue reading show the bookmark's newer cover, and opening a comic updates it too.
- One expired cover no longer stops every cover from the same site from loading for half an hour.
- Bookmarks: the tab bar scrolls again when it has more tabs than fit.
